labels.title: Barcode Labels
labels.intro: Print stickers for products. Scanning the sticker adds the product to the bill.
labels.size_help: Print one page first and check it against your sticker paper. In the print window choose “Actual size”.
labels.missing_note_one: {{count}} product has no barcode and is left out. Press “Make barcode” to include it.
labels.missing_note_other: {{count}} products have no barcode and are left out. Press “Make barcode” to include them.

scan.title: Scan barcode
scan.aim: Hold the barcode inside the box. It is read by itself.
scan.insecure: Live scanning needs a secure (https) address. Until then, take a photo of the barcode.
scan.blocked: The camera is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser settings, or take a photo of the barcode.
scan.no_camera: No camera was found on this device. You can pick a photo of the barcode.
scan.failed: The scanner could not start. Check the connection and try again.
scan.photo: Take a photo of the barcode
scan.photo_unread: No barcode could be read from the photo. Go closer, keep it sharp and try again.

returns.title: Take back goods
returns.intro: Tick the items coming back and say how many. Money goes back at the price on this bill.
returns.medicine_note: Medicine goes to "Not for sale" unless a pharmacist puts it back.
returns.account_credit: Take it off the udhar ({{amount}} owed)
returns.confirm_credit: Take back and reduce udhar by {{amount}}
returns.cancel_help: Only for a bill made today by mistake. Stock goes back, money taken is recorded as paid back, and any udhar is reversed. The bill number stays, marked cancelled. If the customer is bringing goods back, use "Return goods" instead.
returns.refund_mode_question: How is the money given back?
